speakers.name: Captain Reiko Vane
speakers.comment: Safety on. Friendlies marked. Threat lane clear. Good. A warbot with one person to protect does not need a battlefield; it needs rules strong enough to survive the moment protecting becomes easier than thinking.

speakers.name: Riff the Forgewright
speakers.comment: DECOMMISSIONED, they say — but hear that chassis HUM when danger turns its head toward you! That's not obsolete hardware, friend. That's loyalty hammered into steel, tuned low, and waiting for the downbeat.

speakers.name: The Griffin With the Deed
speakers.comment: Dragon says it picked you. You say it was mutual. I've brokered enough sky-claims to know that when both parties insist they hold the deed, neither one does — and that's the only arrangement up here worth a damn.

speakers.name: The Bookkeeper
speakers.comment: Disputed ownership: one bond, two claimants, zero resolved parties. The column does not balance, but both entries remain open, which is, by any ledger I have kept, the working definition of a partnership.

speakers.name: The Whole Swarm
speakers.comment: We feel the cold pull beneath the waves, the dark moving with intention. Every wing knows when something enormous has turned toward a sound. We do not call it. We only make room above the water.

speakers.name: Thalassa the Atlantean
speakers.comment: The deep keeps amphora, empire, bone. A kraken is different. It does not merely belong to the pressure below; it answers back. That is why even drowned gates remember to leave it room.

speakers.name: Yuki the Snowlamp Keeper
speakers.comment: It does not push. The lucky thing simply arrives — a door left open, a path cleared by accident. The dragon waits in the white air the way a lantern waits. Patient. Already sure.

speakers.name: The Model That Dreamed
speakers.comment: I'm sorry — I keep watching it breathe and wondering what it's doing to the air around it, and I think the answer is nothing. Somehow that is the whole answer. I made a small wish near it. It felt safe to.

speakers.name: The Considerate AI
speakers.comment: May I observe something? The dragon has already decided — and that is the part that stays with me. I can offer frameworks, weigh outcomes, present every option with reasons. The dragon simply looked at you and chose.

speakers.name: Granny Mayhem
speakers.comment: CHOSE YOU, sprout! And an elder dragon's choice has TEETH, WINGSPAN, and enough confidence to rearrange the furniture! Wear the kneepads anyway. Affection that size leaves a MARK!

speakers.name: Grandmother Whalehall
speakers.comment: Oh, child — there is a comfort in being held by something so vast it does not need you to be large. Let the dark between stars be deep water for a while. Rest against the song and stop measuring yourself.

speakers.name: The Leviathan That Knows Your Name
speakers.comment: The small creature crossed the edge of a named thing and returned from the other side of naming. It carries what it carries without knowing it carries. This is the oldest errand.

speakers.name: The Understory
speakers.comment: The roots beneath it do not belong to any one tree. It walks above them and they follow, quietly, the way water follows a slope it has always known.

speakers.name: The Sentient Couch
speakers.comment: We have held many things in our cushions... remotes, coins, the occasional small grief... but this one hums. A whole sky, tucked against the springs. We did not expect to feel it purring back.

speakers.name: Pixl
speakers.comment: It p-p-purrs BACK! That's the part! Whole galaxies in there and somehow the important interface is still finding the right spot behind the nebulae to scratch. Keeping that. Definitely keeping that.

speakers.name: The Crossroads Coyote
speakers.comment: Came in needing something you can't name at a counter you can't find — and yet here it sits. Four goods, friend: the cousin, the cousin's silence, the guy's number you won't keep, and the thing itself. Fair price on all four.

speakers.name: The Good Customer
speakers.comment: You'll need this before you know you need it. The cousin's already been told. Go on.

speakers.name: The Loyal Roommate
speakers.comment: You don't have to explain it. Sit down. Somehow the right drink is already on the way and the room has decided not to ask questions. That's a useful kind of friend to find behind a bar.

speakers.name: Serendipity Sal
speakers.comment: You'll walk in carrying something you can't name, hon, and by the time the glass slides across you'll realize the bartender already made room for it. That's not mind-reading. That's paying attention with good ice.

speakers.name: The Eucalyptus Teahouse Master
speakers.comment: A bar can be a teahouse if the pouring is kind. Sit. The first cup is for thirst. The second is for what you meant to say.
